post.description:
Record one tap on a run: start, next, lap, skip, pause, resume, stop, finish or discard.

stored and answered with 200 and ``effect: "void"``. ``run_id`` may be an alias: the
event applies to the run it was merged into, and ``run.id`` says which.

get.description:
Timing stats over the topic's timed entries (timers.md §9): best, median and mean run
totals over complete runs, per step, laps, pauses and one series point per run. The filters
are getTopicStats's; ``version`` keeps that version's runs, labels still come from the latest.
A topic that isn't timed answers zero counts.

head.description: The server's highest seq. A client cursor above it means the database was restored or reset: treat it like an epoch change.

ChangesPage.title: ChangesPage
ChangesPage.description:
One page of the change feed, read from a single consistent snapshot.

Each changed entity appears once, in its latest state (``items``) or as a deletion
(``deleted``). Apply ``items`` in order (topics, then versions, then entries, then runs),
then ``deleted`` (runs, then entries, then versions, then topics), then store ``next`` as
the cursor.

FeedDeletion.title: FeedDeletion
FeedDeletion.description:
A permanently deleted id. A topic deletion also deletes all of its versions, entries and
runs. A ``run`` deletion means the run is no longer open or finishing: it stopped, was
discarded, or went with its topic.

FeedRun.title: FeedRun
FeedRun.description:
A run that is open or finishing in the page's snapshot (timers.md §7.1). A closed run
leaves the feed as a ``run`` deletion; a stopped run's data arrives as its entry.

key.description: Stable machine key (lower snake_case); the identity of a question across versions.

Timer.title: Timer
Timer.description: A version's timing: its steps, timed in this order. No steps makes a plain stopwatch.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: No steps, or every step has a segment and none was skipped.

edited.title: Edited
edited.description: The times were edited after the run stopped.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Skipped step keys, in step order.

Timing.title: Timing
Timing.description:
A finished run's times (timers.md §2.3). Every instant is a whole millisecond;
``ended_at`` equals the entry's ``captured_at``.

median_ms.title: Median Ms
median_ms.description: Of each such run's summed lap time.

step.title: Step
step.description: The step's key; null for a lap.

label.title: Label
label.description: The step's label in the run's version, or 'Lap n'.

paused_ms.title: Paused Ms
paused_ms.description: Its overlap with the run's pauses.

TimingSegment.title: TimingSegment
TimingSegment.description: One segment of a finished run: a named step's time, or an unnamed lap's.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Each step segment's key and its active_ms.

label.title: Label
label.description: The latest version's label for the key, else its latest segment's.

current.title: Current
current.description: The key is a step of the current version.

done.title: Done
done.description: Runs with a segment for the step.

best_ms.title: Best Ms
best_ms.description: Over the done segments' active_ms, from every run.

TimingSummary.title: TimingSummary
TimingSummary.description: Best, median and mean of active times in milliseconds; null when there are none.

timer.description: Makes the topic timed (optional; null: not timed).

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Bumped on every change to the topic's own fields.

schedule_updated_at.title: Schedule Updated At
schedule_updated_at.description: When the schedule was last set or changed; due status ignores anything before it.

due.description: Null when the topic has no schedule.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: One entry per question in the current version plus any historic questions with data.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Bumped on every change to the topic's own fields.

schedule_updated_at.title: Schedule Updated At
schedule_updated_at.description: When the schedule was last set or changed; due status ignores anything before it.

due.description: Null when the topic has no schedule.

total.description: Best, median and mean run totals, over complete runs only.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: Every step key seen in range: the current version's steps in step order, then the rest by key.

series.title: Series
series.description: One point per timed entry, by captured_at then entry_id.

TopicTiming.title: TopicTiming
TopicTiming.description:
Timing stats over the timed entries in range (timers.md §9). Durations are active
time in integer milliseconds; untimed entries count toward nothing here.

expected_revision.title: Expected Revision
expected_revision.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard: the revision this change was based on. When it no longer matches, the change is rejected with 409 stale_revision.

TopicUpdate.title: TopicUpdate
TopicUpdate.description:
Metadata-only update. Omitted fields are unchanged; ``schedule: null`` clears the schedule.

Questions change via versions.

timer.description: Null when this version is not timed.

base_version.title: Base Version
base_version.description: The version this edit was based on. Must equal the topic's current version (optimistic concurrency); otherwise 409.

timer.description: The new version's timer, or null for an untimed topic. Required, so leaving it out can't switch timing off: send the current version's timer to keep it.

base_version.title: Base Version
base_version.description: Optional: the version this draft was based on. When given and stale, the dry run fails with 409 just as publishing would.

timer.description: Optional: the draft's timer (null for untimed). When given, a timer change with no question changes is a change, as publishing treats it; the report itself covers questions only.
